snippet.title: Chessemble: Deckbuilding Chess - Reveal Trailer
snippet.description:
Chessemble is a deckbuilding chess game, craft your formation and outwit your opponents. Available on steam to Wishlist, or play the demo now.

Wishlist: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3841900?utm_source=yotube

Challenges, multiplayer, new chess pieces, and much more.
